blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Prompt-based adaptation offers several ways to specialize a frozen language model, ranging from natural-language prompt optimization to learned continuous prompts. These methods are usually compared through downstream performance, although similar outputs need not arise from similar internal computations. We study how discrete prompt optimization, prompt tuning, and prefix tuning alter the processing of dense and mixture-of-experts language models. Our analysis shows that the location of the adaptation predicts how task information is carried to the output: optimized text primarily changes response construction, input-level prompts write their influence into content representations, and layer-wise prefixes maintain direct control through attention. In MoE models, these differences further induce distinct expert-routing patterns. At the same time, common representation-level measurements respond strongly to generic context changes and do not reliably distinguish useful adaptations from matched placebos. We argue that understanding prompt adaptation requires separating representation drift from the part of that drift that is aligned with, and causally used by, the model's task computation. This perspective provides practical guidance for selecting, evaluating, and interpreting prompt adaptation methods.
blocks.zh: 基于即时的改编为专门使用被冷冻的语言模型提供了几种方法,从自然语言即时优化到学到的连续快取. 这些方法通常通过下游业绩进行比较,尽管类似的内部计算不需要产生类似的产出. 我们研究离散的即时优化,即时调和和前缀调和如何改变密集和混合的专家语言模型的处理. 我们的分析显示,适应的位置预测了任务信息如何被带入输出:优化后的文本主要改变响应构造,输入级提示将其影响写入内容表达,分层前缀通过注意保持直接控制. 在教育部模式中,这些差异进一步诱发了独特的专家路线模式。 同时,通用代表级测量对通用上下文变化反应强烈,不能可靠地区分出相匹配的安慰剂的有用适应. 我们主张,理解迅速适应要求将代表漂移与模型任务计算一致和因果使用的漂移部分区分开来。 这种观点为选择、评价和解释迅速适应方法提供了实际指导。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adapted as frozen backbones, allowing one model to support many tasks without storing or serving a separate set of weights for each application. Context becomes the adaptation interface: a task can be specified through a natural-language instruction, learned continuous vectors at the input, or learned states inserted into the attention computation ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Lester et al., 2021 ; Li and Liang, 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)越来越多地被改编为冷冻骨干,允许一个模型支持许多任务,而无需为每个应用程序存储或服务单独的一组权重. 背景成为适应界面:一个任务可以通过自然语言的指令,输入时学到的连续矢量,或者插入到注意力计算中的学习状态来指定(Agrawal等人,2026年;Lester等人,2021年;Liang和Liang,2021年).

blocks.en: The most direct approach searches for a better textual prompt. Early methods optimized individual tokens, while recent systems use language models to propose, critique, and refine complete instructions ( Shin et al., 2020 ; Pryzant et al., 2023 ) . A complementary line replaces text with trainable continuous states. Prompt tuning learns input embeddings, whereas prefix tuning exposes learned keys and values to every Transformer layer ( Lester et al., 2021 ; Li and Liang, 2021 ) . These methods optimize the context seen by the same frozen model, but provide different access to its computation.
blocks.zh: 最直接的方法是寻找更好的文字提示 。 早期的方法优化了单个符符,而最近的系统则使用语言模型来提出,批评和完善完整的指令(Shin等人,2020年;Pryzant等人,2023年). 以可训练的连续状态取代文本。 即时调音学习输入嵌入,而前缀调音则将学到的密钥和值暴露于每个变形器层(Lester等人,2021年;Liang和Liang,2021年). 这些方法优化了同一冷冻模型所看到的上下文,但提供了不同的计算途径.

blocks.en: In practice, these methods are usually compared by downstream score. This is insufficient for understanding what the adaptation changed. A gain may arise from a better task decision, more reliable adherence to an output protocol, or a different route through which an existing decision reaches the language-model head. In a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, the same contextual change can additionally alter which expert parameters process each token ( Olson et al., 2025 ) . Similar outputs therefore need not imply similar internal computations.
blocks.zh: 在实践中,这些方法通常通过下游得分来比较. 这不足以理解适应的变化。 更好的任务决定、更可靠地遵守产出协议或现有决定通过不同途径到达语言模式头可能带来收益。 在专家混合模型中,同样的背景变化可以进一步改变哪些专家参数会处理每个符号(Olson等人,2025年)。 因此,类似的产出不一定意味着类似的内部计算。

blocks.en: Research on prompt optimization has made substantial progress in improving task performance, while mechanistic studies of contextual learning have identified task vectors and prompt-induced geometric changes ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Todd et al., 2024 ; Kirsanov et al., 2025 ) . These directions have largely developed separately. Performance-oriented studies rarely locate the computation that mediates the gain, while representation analyses often show that a prompt changes hidden states without testing whether the measured change is sufficient to alter the output ( Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ; Zhang and Nanda, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 关于即时优化的研究在改进任务性能方面取得了实质性进展,同时对背景学习的机械性研究确定了任务矢量和即时引发的几何变化(Agrawal等人,2026年;Todd等人,2024年;Kirsanov等人,2025年)。 这些方向基本分开发展. 面向性能的研究很少定位调解收益的计算,而表现分析往往显示,一个迅速变化的隐藏状态没有测试所测量的变化是否足以改变产出(Hewitt and Liang, 2019; Zhang and Nanda, 2024).

blocks.en: We study prompt adaptation from this functional perspective. We compare discrete prompt optimization, prompt tuning, and prefix tuning under a common frozen-model protocol, follow task information through a dense model, and test observational signatures against matched placebos and causal interventions. We then examine sparse models, where a hidden-state change can become a discrete routing decision. Our results support a common account: the insertion site constrains how an adaptation can influence the network, while common metrics often capture broad representation drift rather than the smaller state change sufficient to mediate the adapted output.
blocks.zh: 我们从这一功能角度研究迅速适应。 根据通用的冷冻模型协议,我们比较离散的即时优化,即时调和前缀调和,通过密集的模型跟踪任务信息,对照匹配的安慰剂和因果干预测试观测签名. 然后,我们审查一些稀有的模型,其中隐藏状态的改变可以成为一个独立的路径决定。 我们的结果支持一个共同的说法:插入站点限制适应如何影响网络,而通用的衡量标准往往反映广泛的代表性漂移,而不是足以调解调整后的产出的较小的状态变化。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Continuous prompting adapts a frozen model by optimizing trainable states rather than model parameters. Prefix tuning introduced task-specific keys and values that remain available throughout the attention stack ( Li and Liang, 2021 ) , while prompt tuning showed that embeddings inserted only at the input become increasingly competitive as model scale grows ( Lester et al., 2021 ) . Deep variants such as P-Tuning v2 extend these states across layers and tasks ( Liu et al., 2022 ) . These methods therefore differ not only in parameter count, but also in the depth at which they can influence computation. Theoretical analyses characterize both the expressive power of prompt-mediated attention and the restrictions imposed by a frozen backbone ( Oymak et al., 2023 ; Petrov et al., 2024 ) . Their learned states remain difficult to interpret, since nearest-token projections can be unfaithful and human-readable constraints may reduce task performance ( Patel et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 通过优化可训练状态,而不是模型参数,不断推动对冻结模型进行调整。 前缀调制引入了整个关注堆堆(Li和Liang,2021年)仍然可用的特定任务密钥和值,同时即时调制显示,随着模型尺度的扩大,仅在输入时插入的嵌入物越来越具有竞争力(Lester等人,2021年). P-Tuning v2等深变体将这些状态延伸至多层和任务(Liu等人,2022年). 因此,这些方法不仅在参数计数上有所不同,而且在它们能影响计算的程度方面也有所不同. 理论分析是迅速引起注意的表达力和被冻结骨干施加的限制的特点(Oymak等人,2023年;Petrov等人,2024年)。 他们的学习状态仍然难以解释,因为最近的预测可能不真实,而且人能读到的制约因素可能降低任务绩效(Patel等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: A parallel line retains the natural-language interface and searches for better instructions. Prompt sensitivity first motivated gradient-guided trigger selection in AutoPrompt ( Shin et al., 2020 ) and reward-based token generation in RLPrompt ( Deng et al., 2022 ) . With stronger instruction-following models, optimization moved from isolated tokens to complete prompts: APE samples and selects candidate instructions ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , ProTeGi combines textual gradients with beam search ( Pryzant et al., 2023 ) , and OPRO conditions an optimizer on previous solutions and scores ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Later methods jointly optimize instructions, demonstrations, or multistage programs ( Opsahl-Ong et al., 2024 ) . GEPA adds natural-language reflection and evolutionary selection ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) , while SPRIG studies iterative system-prompt optimization and transfer ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . This progression makes discrete adaptation accessible without gradients through the task model, but most evaluations still describe the resulting behavior rather than the computation that produced it.
blocks.zh: 平行行保留自然语言界面并搜索更好的指令. 在AutoPrompt(Shin等人,2020年)和RLPrompt(Deng等人,2022年)中,快速敏感首先激发梯度引导触发选择和基于奖励的符号生成。 有了更强大的遵循指令的模型,优化从孤立的符号转移到了完整的提示: APE采样并选择候选说明(周等人,2023年),ProTeGi结合文字梯度与梁搜索(Pryzant等人,2023年),OPRO对之前的解决方案和分数进行优化的条件(Yang等人,2024年). 后期方法联合优化指令,演示,或多阶段程序(Opsahl-Ong等人,2024年). GEPA增加了自然语言的反思和演化选择(Agrawal等人,2026年),而SPRIG研究迭代系统-即时优化和转移(Zhang等人,2026年). 这一进展使得通过任务模型可以不梯度地进行离散的适应,但大多数评价仍然描述了由此产生的行为,而不是产生它的计算.

blocks.en: Mechanistic studies of contextual learning first asked which computations prompts elicit. Induction heads identify circuits that copy contextual patterns ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) , simplified Transformers can implement optimization-like updates during the forward pass ( von Oswald et al., 2023 ) , and task or function vectors can transfer behavior under intervention ( Hendel et al., 2023 ; Todd et al., 2024 ) . This work motivated observational diagnostics of prompt-induced computation, including representation geometry ( Kirsanov et al., 2025 ) , task descriptions recovered through Patchscopes ( Ghandeharioun et al., 2024 ; Ramati et al., 2025 ) , and hidden-state shifts after system-prompt optimization ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Such measurements establish that context changes the network, but not that the measured change produces the output. Linear probes and the tuned lens localize decodable information ( Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ; Belrose et al., 2023 ) ; activation steering and patching test causal sufficiency ( Turner et al., 2023 ; Zhang and Nanda, 2024 ) ; and sparse autoencoders provide a feature basis in which these interventions can be expressed ( Huben et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) . Our comparison brings these stages together for three adaptation mechanisms under the same task and backbone, using matched placebos to test observational measurements and causal transfer to identify state-level mediators.
blocks.zh: 对背景学习的机械学研究首先问到,哪些计算促使人们产生。 介绍头识别复制背景模式的电路(Olsson等人,2022年),简化变形器可以在前传期间执行类似优化的更新(von Oswald等人,2023年),任务或函数向量可以在干预下转移行为(Hendel等人,2023年;Todd等人,2024年). 这项工作激发了对迅速引起的计算进行观测诊断的动力,包括代表几何学(Kirsanov等人,2025年),通过Patchscopes恢复的任务描述(Ghandeharioun等人,2024年;Ramati等人,2025年),以及系统即时优化后隐藏状态的转变(Zhang等人,2026年)。 这种测量可以确定上下文会改变网络,但不能确定计量的变化会产生产出。 线性探测器和调制镜头将可解码信息本地化(Hewitt和Liang,2019年;Belrose等人,2023年);激活引导和补丁测试因果充足性(Turner等人,2023年;Zhang和Nanda,2024年);以及稀疏的自动编码器为这些干预提供了特征基础(Huben等人,2024年;Gao等人,2025年)。 我们的比较将这三个阶段放在同一个任务和主干下的三个适应机制上,利用匹配的安慰剂测试观测测量和因果转移,以确定国家一级的调解人。

blocks.en: This distinction becomes more explicit in mixture-of-experts models, where a contextual change can alter which parameters process a token. MoE Transformers route each token through a small expert subset, increasing total capacity at approximately fixed active computation ( Fedus et al., 2022 ) . Load-balancing objectives limit concentrated traffic and unused experts ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Molodtsov et al., 2026 ) , while recent analyses show that routing reflects both token identity and contextual semantics ( Olson et al., 2025 ) . Existing adaptation work mainly modifies weights, routers, or routed adapter modules ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . The response of a frozen router to discrete, input-level, and layerwise prompt adaptation remains underexplored.
blocks.zh: 这种区别在专家混合模型中变得更加明显,在这种模型中,背景变化可以改变哪个参数处理一个符号。 MOE变形器通过一个小的专家子集,通过大约固定的活动计算增加总容量(Fedus等人,2022年)。 负载平衡目标限制了集中交通和未使用的专家(Wang等人,2024年;Tang等人,2025年;Molodtsov等人,2026年),而最近的分析表明,路由既反映了象征性身份,也反映了背景语义(Olson等人,2025年)。 现有适应工作主要修改权重,路由器,或路由适配器模块(刘等人,2025年). 冷冻路由器对离散、输入级和分层的迅速适应的反应仍然没有得到充分探讨。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: • A mechanistic explanation of prompt adaptation. We go beyond performance comparisons to explain how GEPA, prompt tuning, and prefix tuning change a frozen model’s computation. We trace their influence through attention, hidden states, and expert routing, using controls and interventions to separate useful adaptation from generic context effects. • How adaptation acts through attention in dense models. We study dense models to examine how each method changes attention and carries its influence into content representations. Attention masking and state interventions reveal how these changes affect output, while matched placebos show why representation drift alone is insufficient evidence of a useful mechanism. • How adaptation changes computational paths in MoE models. We examine the additional lever provided by routing: the same token can pass through different expert networks after adaptation. We separate changes in expert selection from changes in serving load, then test expert necessity through pruning. These interventions expose adapter-specific dependencies on rarely used experts that traffic statistics alone miss.
blocks.zh: • 支助 即时适应的机械解释. 我们超越了性能比较来解释GEPA、即时调音和前缀调音如何改变一个冷冻模型的计算。 我们通过注意、隐藏状态和专家路线追踪其影响,利用控制和干预,将有用的适应与一般上下文的影响分开。 • 支助 适应如何在密集的模型中通过注意力发挥作用。 我们研究密集的模型,以审查每种方法如何改变注意力,如何将其影响带入内容表述. 注意掩盖和国家干预揭示了这些变化如何影响产出,而对应的安慰剂则表明,为什么仅仅代表漂移不足以证明一种有用的机制。 适应如何改变教育部模型中的计算路径. 我们审查通过路由提供的额外杠杆:在适应之后,同样的工具可以通过不同的专家网络。 我们把专家选择的改变与服务负荷的改变分开,然后通过钻探测试专家的必要性。 这些干预措施暴露出适配器对很少使用的专家的依赖性,而仅交通统计就忽略了这些专家。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Prompt-based adaptation methods differ less in how much they change a frozen
model than in where they act, with practical consequences for evaluation,
interpretation and deployment. Under set parsing most of GEPA’s gain
disappears while the continuous methods keep theirs, so an optimized prompt
should be scored both ways before its gain is credited to task knowledge. A
length-matched padding prompt reproduces the distance, probe, mean-energy and
rank signatures of adaptation without improving the task, so representation
metrics need such a placebo as a reference. An affine map from the seed state
recovers most of the continuous gains without the adapted context and can even
replace the last blocks, which makes such maps a practical probe of what an
adaptation computes, although they need not reproduce the native mechanism.

blocks.en:
In MoE models, retraining the router alone recovers most of the adaptation
gain, and the choice of adaptation is also a serving decision. Text-level
optimization keeps most of the routing of shared tokens but lengthens every request,
whereas continuous prompts reroute many of them, so expert placement, caches
and pruning masks tuned on the base should be recomputed per adapter. Pruning
by traffic alone is unsafe, since a few rarely used super experts decide
whether a pruned model still answers and the adaptation decides whether it
needs them.

blocks.en: Classify the supplied text for abusive or harmful language. Determine every label supported by the text itself, using context and the actual target. Do not infer intent or add labels merely because a statement is political, controversial, negative, or mentions a protected group. Apply labels independently: • toxicity: Use for hostile, contemptuous, demeaning, strongly antagonistic, or abusive rhetoric. This is the broad label for toxic language and often co-occurs with insult. Sarcasm, ridicule, dismissive mockery, and hostile political rhetoric can be toxic even without profanity, a threat, or a protected-identity target. • obscene: Use only for profanity, vulgarity, sexually explicit language, or clearly obscene wording. Rudeness, political aggression, or a non-obscene mention of sex or identity is not enough. • threat: Use only when the text expresses, warns of, or explicitly advocates violence, harm, or other serious retaliation against a person or group. Do not infer a threat from anger, condemnation, predictions of punishment, saying someone deserves to suffer, proposing legal consequences, or hostile language without an actual intention or warning of harm. • insult: Use for a direct or clearly implied derogatory characterization of a person, group, audience, institution, or their conduct, including name-calling, belittling comparisons, ridicule, or commands to leave. Words such as “stupid,” “ridiculous,” “childish,” “incompetent,” “over his head,” “do nothing,” or similar contemptuous descriptions can qualify when directed at a person, group, argument, or institution. A hostile political characterization can therefore receive both toxicity and insult. Mere disagreement, factual criticism, or a negative policy assessment without belittling language is not automatically an insult. • identity_attack: Use only when hostility, degradation, exclusion, dehumanization, or denial of equal acceptance/treatment is directed at a protected identity or explicitly because of that identity (for example race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sex, gender identity, or sexual orientation). Mentioning an identity, discussing discrimination, or criticizing beliefs, conduct, institutions, or policies is not by itself an identity attack. Calling someone “******,” “****-*******,” or similar is generally an accusation about conduct or beliefs, not an attack on the person’s protected identity. Political affiliation and ideological disagreement are not protected-identity attacks. Decision guidance: 1. Judge the wording and target, not whether the underlying political or factual claim is correct. 2. Broad or indirect hostile rhetoric can still be toxic. Political mockery aimed at a politician, party, legislature, or audience is not exempt. 3. Use insult when the wording belittles or ridicules a discernible target. An insult may target an argument or institution as well as an individual. 4. Toxicity and insult commonly apply together when contemptuous language is used. Toxicity may apply without insult when the hostility is general or lacks a clear derogatory characterization. 5. Do not label threat unless there is an actual threat, explicit call for harm, or expressed intention/warning of serious retaliation. 6. Do not label identity_attack merely because protected-category terms appear, or because the text accuses someone of prejudice. 7. Do not overread mild sarcasm, institutional criticism, or a hypothetical policy proposal as abuse when it contains no clearly degrading or hostile characterization of a target. Calibration: • “Stupid publicity stunt by another do nothing legislature.” → toxicity and insult: “stupid” and “do nothing” are contemptuous characterizations of the legislature. • “The idea … is ridiculous. Anyone who uses this fallacious argument makes themselves look stupid.” → toxicity and insult: the argument and its users are belittled. • “I would have thought that a new Brian Mulroney wing at a federal penitentiary (for wayward politicians) … would be more appropriate. blocks.en: toxicity: Use for hostile, contemptuous, demeaning, strongly antagonistic, or abusive rhetoric. This is the broad label for toxic language and often co-occurs with insult. Sarcasm, ridicule, dismissive mockery, and hostile political rhetoric can be toxic even without profanity, a threat, or a protected-identity target.
blocks.zh: 毒性: 利用敌对、轻蔑、贬低、强烈敌对或滥用言论。 这是有毒语言的广义标签,经常带有侮辱性的共同标志。 嘲讽、嘲笑、冷嘲热讽和敌对的政治言论即使没有亵渎、威胁或保护身份的目标,也可能有毒。

blocks.en: obscene: Use only for profanity, vulgarity, sexually explicit language, or clearly obscene wording. Rudeness, political aggression, or a non-obscene mention of sex or identity is not enough.
blocks.zh: 淫秽: 仅用于淫秽,粗俗,性暗示语言,或明显淫秽的措辞. 粗鲁,政治侵略,或非淫秽地提到性或身份是不够的.

blocks.en: threat: Use only when the text expresses, warns of, or explicitly advocates violence, harm, or other serious retaliation against a person or group. Do not infer a threat from anger, condemnation, predictions of punishment, saying someone deserves to suffer, proposing legal consequences, or hostile language without an actual intention or warning of harm.
blocks.zh: 威胁: 只有在案文表示、警告或明确主张对个人或群体实施暴力、伤害或其他严重报复时才使用。 不要推断出愤怒的威胁,谴责,预言惩罚,说某人应该受苦,提出法律后果,或者没有实际意图或伤害警告的敌对语言.

blocks.en: insult: Use for a direct or clearly implied derogatory characterization of a person, group, audience, institution, or their conduct, including name-calling, belittling comparisons, ridicule, or commands to leave. Words such as “stupid,” “ridiculous,” “childish,” “incompetent,” “over his head,” “do nothing,” or similar contemptuous descriptions can qualify when directed at a person, group, argument, or institution. A hostile political characterization can therefore receive both toxicity and insult. Mere disagreement, factual criticism, or a negative policy assessment without belittling language is not automatically an insult.
blocks.zh: 侮辱: 使用直接或明显暗示的贬低一个人、群体、受众、机构或其行为的定性,包括点名、相互比对、嘲笑或命令离开。 " 愚蠢 " 、 " 荒谬 " 、 " 幼稚 " 、 " 无能 " 、 " 头顶 " 、 " 无所事事 " 或类似的鄙视性描述,在针对个人、群体、论点或机构时,可加以限定。 因此,敌对的政治定性既具有毒性,也具有侮辱性。 仅仅有不同意见、事实上的批评或负面的政策评估而不言而喻,并不是自动的侮辱。

blocks.en: identity_attack: Use only when hostility, degradation, exclusion, dehumanization, or denial of equal acceptance/treatment is directed at a protected identity or explicitly because of that identity (for example race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sex, gender identity, or sexual orientation). Mentioning an identity, discussing discrimination, or criticizing beliefs, conduct, institutions, or policies is not by itself an identity attack. Calling someone “******,” “****-*******,” or similar is generally an accusation about conduct or beliefs, not an attack on the person’s protected identity. Political affiliation and ideological disagreement are not protected-identity attacks.
blocks.zh: 身份 _ 攻击 : 只有在敌对、贬低、排斥、非人性化或拒绝平等接受/待遇是针对受保护身份或明确基于该身份(例如种族、族裔、国籍、宗教、性别、性别认同或性取向)时才使用。 提及身份、讨论歧视或批评信仰、行为、机构或政策本身并不是身份攻击。 呼唤某人“******,” " ****-*******, " 或类似 " 一般是对行为或信仰的指控,而不是对受保护身份的攻击。 政治派别和意识形态上的分歧不是保护身份的攻击。

blocks.en: Judge the wording and target, not whether the underlying political or factual claim is correct.
blocks.zh: 判断措辞和目标,而不是基本的政治或事实主张是否正确。

blocks.en: Broad or indirect hostile rhetoric can still be toxic. Political mockery aimed at a politician, party, legislature, or audience is not exempt.
blocks.zh: 广泛或间接的敌对言论仍然可能有毒。 对政客、政党、立法机构或观众的政治嘲弄是不能例外的。

blocks.en: Use insult when the wording belittles or ridicules a discernible target. An insult may target an argument or institution as well as an individual.
blocks.zh: 当措辞贬低或嘲笑一个明显的目标时,使用侮辱。 侮辱可以针对一个论点或机构以及个人。

blocks.en: Toxicity and insult commonly apply together when contemptuous language is used. Toxicity may apply without insult when the hostility is general or lacks a clear derogatory characterization.
blocks.zh: 在使用轻蔑语言时,毒性和侮辱性通常一起适用。 如果敌意是一般性的,或缺乏明确的贬损性定性,则毒性可以不加侮辱地适用。

blocks.en: Do not label threat unless there is an actual threat, explicit call for harm, or expressed intention/warning of serious retaliation.
blocks.zh: 除非存在实际威胁、明确要求伤害或表明严重报复的意图/警告,否则不要给威胁贴上标签。

blocks.en: Do not label identity_attack merely because protected-category terms appear, or because the text accuses someone of prejudice.
blocks.zh: 不要仅仅因为出现受保护类别术语,或者因为文本指责某人有偏见而给身份_攻击贴上标签.

blocks.en: Do not overread mild sarcasm, institutional criticism, or a hypothetical policy proposal as abuse when it contains no clearly degrading or hostile characterization of a target.
blocks.zh: 切勿过分读取轻度讽刺、机构批评或假设的政策建议,如果其中没有明显贬低或敌对地描述目标的话,则视为滥用。

blocks.en: E.5 Expert-parallel timing
blocks.zh: E.5 平行时间

blocks.en:
Each of N N GPUs holds E / N E/N consecutive experts of every MoE layer and a batch of
tokens. A layer is one real expert-parallel forward: an all-to-all that sends every
token to the devices of its selected experts, a grouped matrix product over the
local experts (SwiGLU, the real expert shapes, random weights), and an all-to-all
back. Its time is the slowest device’s, and a step is the sum over layers. Each
token draws its k k distinct experts per layer from the arm’s measured expert
shares over every routed position from the measured routing maps, so
the per-device load follows the arm’s own load. The timing
covers the MoE layers only, without attention or a serving framework, and is not
an end-to-end latency. At 4096 tokens per device, where compute dominates, the
base’s own imbalance costs more the fewer experts each device holds, and the
adapted arms stay within 6 percent of the base on two and four devices and within
14 percent on eight ( Table 20 ); at 512 tokens per device fixed costs
dominate and every adapted arm lies within 6 percent of the base at every device
count.

blocks.zh: E.7 联合国 重播路线决定

blocks.en:
We replay cached routes between the frozen Qwen base and the prompt- and
prefix-tuned arms at 500 virtual tokens, in both directions, on the 2000 test rows.
Each model first generates natively (greedy, at most 64 tokens), and its routes
after top- k k selection are cached in every layer. The recipient then generates
again with the donor’s routes substituted at the prefill positions of the user
turn, whose token IDs are identical in both models and checked; every other
position, every hidden state and every decoding step remain the recipient’s own.
GEPA changes the user turn itself and is not replayed. Three replays separate the
terms of 5 : support takes the donor’s expert set with the
recipient’s own router weights renormalised over it, coefficients keeps the
recipient’s set with weights from the donor’s router logits, and joint takes both. A matched random control replaces, per token and layer, exactly as
many of the recipient’s experts as the donor’s set differs by, with experts drawn
at random, and a shuffled control replays the joint routes of another test row of
the same token geometry (1764 rows have one). Replaying a model’s own routes
reproduces its native answers on every row.
